---
title: "Software"
---

The main lab-stack playbook installs and configures most documented software through focused Ansible roles. Use the individual pages to run a role by tag, understand what it manages, complete any manual account or GUI setup, and verify the result. Start with [Install software](install_software.qmd) when configuring the complete workstation rather than running every role separately.

| Area | Software and configuration pages |
|---|---|
| Base system and development | [Baseline](baseline.qmd), [Git tools](git.qmd), [Nemo file manager](nemo.qmd), [VS Code](vscode.qmd) |
| Storage, backup, and security | [Borg/Vorta](borg_vorta.qmd), [Dropbox](dropbox.qmd), [VeraCrypt](veracrypt.qmd), [KeePassXC](keepassxc.qmd) |
| Communication and productivity | [Chrome](chrome.qmd), [Thunderbird](thunderbird.qmd), [Thunderbird MCP](thunderbird-mcp.qmd), [Teams](teams.qmd), [ONLYOFFICE](onlyoffice.qmd), [Okular](okular.qmd) |
| Research, writing, and data analysis | [LanguageTool](languagetool.qmd), [LaTeX](latex.qmd), [Quarto](quarto.qmd), [R](r.qmd), [RStudio Desktop](rstudio.qmd), [Obsidian](obsidian.qmd) |
| Containers and virtualization | [Docker](docker.qmd), [VirtualBox](virtualbox.qmd) |
| AI and document processing services | [OCRmyPDF](ocr.qmd), [GROBID](grobid.qmd), [LLM](llm.qmd) |

The pages distinguish shared Ansible-managed state from manual steps such as signing in, supplying credentials, choosing personal settings, or creating data stores. The [LLM](llm.qmd) page describes an explicitly manual area that is not currently part of the main playbook.
